title: Skill Cleave
wikitext: Classes: WAR This ability cleaves your target with your primary and optionally secondary weapon, then attacks up to 3 additional enemies in front of you. Reduces the cooldown time of the Rampage AA. Cleave will double and triple attack based on your skill. Macro command: /doability Cleave Skill Cap at level 50: 200 {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category: Skills]]
